latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the HTML to Markdown skill.

- Provides commands to convert HTML strings, files, and web URLs to Markdown format.
- Integrates with the @siping/html-to-markdown-node npm package.
- Supports options like domain resolution, escape mode, and CSS selector extraction.
- Outputs results in standardized JSON format.
- Includes documentation for usage scenarios, error handling, and supported features.
